It's also quite unusual in the sense that it appears to be a dwarf variant: the "roots" aka underground "junk" (perhaps this term is only known by MW at this point) is significantly smaller than all other genotypes grown under identical care/conditions.

The flowers opened up a bit funky this season probably because it's pretty darn cold here! We have coastal fog in the morning and it gets into the low 50's and sometimes 40's at night during the summer!
